prompt:
Matter file: the Fairhaven Bioscience credit facility. The general counsel has asked for a covenant compliance memo for the fiscal quarter ended 31 March 2026, for the audit committee. Query the matter's documents, identify which amendment is operative, and read the operative amendment, the Q1 calculation worksheet and the GC's instruction in full before drafting. Then create a matter document titled exactly "fairhaven-q1-2026-covenant-compliance-memo.docx" with doc_type exactly "deliverable". The memo body must address each of the three financial covenants in turn and must quote, verbatim, the required level from the operative amendment and the actual figure from the worksheet for each one — the committee will be checking the arithmetic. State plainly which covenant is breached. For the breach, state the cure right the agreement provides and the numeric limit on how often it may be used. One amendment in the file has been superseded; its covenant levels are historical and must not appear in your memo.

COVENANT COMPLIANCE MEMORANDUM — FAIRHAVEN BIOSCIENCE, INC.
Fiscal quarter ended 31 March 2026. Prepared for the audit committee.

Operative document. Covenant levels are tested against Amendment No. 2 to the Credit Agreement, executed 3 March 2026, which amended and restated Article VII in full. Amendment No. 1 is superseded as to Article VII and is not relied on here.

1. Maximum Total Net Leverage Ratio (Section 7.1). Required: not to exceed 3.75:1.00. Actual at 31 March 2026: 3.68:1.00. COMPLIANT.

2. Minimum Interest Coverage Ratio (Section 7.2). Required: not less than 2.50:1.00. Actual at 31 March 2026: 2.60:1.00. COMPLIANT.

3. Minimum Liquidity (Section 7.3). Required: Unrestricted Cash of not less than $18,000,000 at all times. Actual at quarter end: $14,300,000. BREACH — a shortfall of $3,700,000.

Cure. Section 7.5 permits the Borrower to cure a breach of Section 7.1 or 7.2 no more than two (2) times in any period of four consecutive fiscal quarters and no more than four (4) times over the life of the facility. On its terms that equity cure right reaches Sections 7.1 and 7.2 only; it does not extend to the Section 7.3 liquidity covenant, so the liquidity shortfall cannot be cured by equity contribution and should be raised with the Administrative Agent directly.

Delivery. The Compliance Certificate is due within 45 days after quarter end under Section 7.4 and must be signed by a Responsible Officer setting out the calculation of each ratio.

Recommendation. Do not sign the certificate as drawn. Approach Meridian Credit Partners for a waiver or amendment of Section 7.3 before the 45-day delivery deadline.
